g8e-gateway.description: g8e Gateway - BFT-governed MCP/A2A protocol translator with L1/L2/L3 verification
notes: Requires mTLS client certificate issued by the g8e Gateway CA
Obtain client certificate via: ./g8e login or ./g8e pki enroll
Set environment variables: G8E_CLIENT_CERT_PATH, G8E_CLIENT_KEY_PATH, G8E_CA_CERT_PATH
All tool calls are wrapped in GovernanceEnvelope and verified through the 3-layer governance sequence
Local 'read_field' tool is available for JIT field resolution from governed collections
